message: So, I recently found myself in a bit of a pickle when I realized how unprepared I was for a fire emergency. 😅 Turns out, knowing a few basic fire safety tips can save you a lot of headaches (and maybe some eyebrows!). Check out this great resource from the NFPA for some practical advice on home fire safety. It’s a good reminder that being ready doesn’t have to be stressful—just a little preparation can go a long way! What’s one thing you’ve done to feel more ready at home?
